description: Coordinator-side causal decision surface. Actor identity is not a parameter: the server derives the registered instance/session from authenticated call context and verifies it is the immutable spawning coordinator still holding spawned_by_role. Supported actions are request_retry, resolve_blocker, accept_completion, reject_completion, cancel, cancel_legacy_expiry, and accept_verified_legacy_completion. request_retry is explicit and idempotent under the same dispatch_id from uptake_uncertain, failed_start, worker_lost, or expired; retry rearms only uptake/report/watchdog obligations and omits retired lifetime fields. resolve_blocker returns an authorized blocker to active after its ruling. reject_completion returns completion_reported to active for evidence repair. cancel records a normal terminal reason. cancel_legacy_expiry is restricted to legacy expired rows and requires durable no-live-attempt/work-preservation evidence with references. accept_verified_legacy_completion is restricted to legacy expired rows and binds the exact artifact hash, completion-contract digest, full worker evidence/verdict, independent acceptance evidence/verdict, and worker-evidence digest before reaching completed. Every action carries event_id, prior_version, and payload; duplicates are idempotent and stale or unauthorized decisions remain rejected audit events.
embedding_description: Make the coordinator decision for a durable worker lane: resolve a blocker, request one bounded replacement attempt, accept or reject exact completion evidence, or cancel within authority. The acceptance action is the only way a managed dispatch becomes completed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The resulting managed_dispatch projection after the accepted or idempotently replayed coordinator action, including state/version, attempt number/current attempt, blocker/completion evidence, terminal reason, and next action/owner.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with action, resulting state, causal version, next_required_action, and responsible_role. For completed, state that exact artifact/hash/evidence were independently revalidated; do not imply Git landing, deployment, or publication.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Checks event idempotency and causal version, validates that the requested action is legal from the current dispatch state, applies one CAS transition, and appends the coordinator decision. Completion acceptance performs a fresh filesystem read and hash before the state update.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: coordinator_authority_denied means the authenticated caller is not the immutable spawning coordinator holding its durable role. *_not_allowed means the current state cannot take that action. stale_dispatch_version means another event won the race and this rejected decision remains auditable. legacy expiry evidence failures mean the restricted correction did not prove its disposition. completion artifact/hash/contract/evidence/verdict/worker-evidence errors mean independent acceptance failed and the dispatch did not complete. A replacement host error leaves the same dispatch_id in supervised failed_start.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read managed_dispatch_status and decide from the fresh version. Reject or repair completion evidence rather than overriding validation. Route operator-only authority gaps to the operator; this verb does not grant capabilities or authorize Git/live-state mutation.
